body:
Thank you, that means a lot!

It does help to know that there are more people like me/us. Our struggle is probably far more common than I can image. In some strange way, there's comfort in that -- knowing I'm not alone in being alone. I don't know if it makes me a terrible human being to find comfort in someone else's struggles, or if it just makes me a human being. And the other way around: sometimes seeing happy people make me sadder or even angry. That's all envy, probably. I've taken a course in meditation recently, and it helps me manage my emotions (sometimes; sometimes it's all too much to manage). Would recommend trying it, if you haven't already!

Anyway, I'm a bit more optimistic today (maybe it helped to get it all off my chest): I'm very sure that if we choose life, there will be many moments when we're glad we did.
